description: Check which MCP directories already list a public GitHub repo. 10 of the 26 directories have a public lookup, so those come back listed or missing (with the listing URL when listed) and the rest come back unknown. No login and no ManyCP server needed, works on every plan and on repos you do not own. Results are cached for about 10 minutes. Use it before add_server to show the gap, or after submit_server to see what went live.

repo_url.description: The public GitHub repo: https://github.com/owner/name, or just owner/name.

name: check_listings
title: Check where a repo is listed
